steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Scouting complete. I can confirm that the enemies pursuing us have been eliminated.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We've managed to break through their encirclement. We'll be at the outskirts of Chernobog soon.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Even though the enemies we defeated today were just a small portion of the whole force...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: At least we're safe for now.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Thank you for what you did back there. I am forever in your debt.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Don't say stuff like that. I don't have the right to ask the Radiant Knight for repayment anyway.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Anyway, let's talk about that sniper, Nearl.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Putting aside the destructive power of that ballista...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I think... he might have set up several turrets in advance, as well as other automatically-firing devices.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I was targeted from different directions... but I only saw one sniper.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I had the same feeling.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: The first and second shots exploded at about the same time, but there was a noticeable delay between them.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Those shots weren't fired from the same repeating ballista. At least, when we returned fire, we weren't targeting the same sniper.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Ace, did you realize something?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I can't say for sure. What if the enemy was moving so quickly... to the point of basically being in several places at once?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: There's no way anyone could move that quickly. I can't even imagine how it'd be possible.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We can't underestimate how dangerous Reunion is.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It was that malicious brat who ordered the sniper to go after you. He didn't even call upon the sniper when he was attacking us...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Looks like that disgusting personality of his is backed up by some real power.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: However, he never attacked us, even when he was angry.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: So either his combat capabilities are lacking, or he simply chose to not display his true abilities yet.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Just seeing his commanding abilities in action... makes me highly suspicious.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: He was commanding his troops like puppets...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: In any case, we're no longer in territory that he controls.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nearl... Thank you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If not for your timely arrival, we would have been in grave danger.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I was just following the plan we agreed on beforehand.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You were the one who asked me and Ace to make adjustments depending on the situation.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You solved your own problem.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: On my way here, I saw the extent of Reunion's atrocities, and I had doubts about their power.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What if I stopped to engage their forces?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What if I helped Ursus defend against Reunion?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What if I stayed back at the rendezvous point, waiting for you to come to me?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...If I was the one who called the shots, there's no saying how much worse the outcome could have been.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I'm not good at thinking several steps ahead. The only way I know to get what I want is to keep fighting.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Amiya, I was only performing my duties, but you have the ability to end the crisis.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You earned this victory, so have some more confidence in yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Nearl...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: This person standing next to you must be the Doctor, then.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right. But...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Every time we meet someone, Amiya has to repeat the story about how the Doctor is suffering from amnesia. What a pain...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: One of my friends lost her memories as well. I'm sure you two will get along.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: After all, you should understand how precious living in the present is.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mhm...!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Let's get going, everyone.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We still have to escort the Doctor to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Sorry... I failed.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: No, don't apologize. It was my mistake. I lost my temper.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Can you help me track Rhodes Island? I'll report the situation to Talulah first.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: She should have taken over Chernobog's core command tower by now.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...She will decide the fate of these insects.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Be careful. Your safety is the most important thing, all right?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...I will.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...I suppose my mission is complete too.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Let's go, comrades.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Let us go forth and welcome our new era!!
